title: Work-tape head update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $s$ be a snapshot of $M$, let $\tau$ be one of its work tapes, and let $h_\ell,h_m,h_r$ be Boolean indicators for the neighboring cells’ head positions. If $s$ is halted, the updated head indicator is $h_m$; otherwise it is the indicator among $h_\ell,h_m,h_r$ selected by the transition’s movement on tape $\tau$ (left selects $h_\ell$, stationary selects $h_m$, and right selects $h_r$).
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
